text:
alex: quick consolidation of postmortem follow-ups from the GPU surge. opened a single tracking lane. please confirm owners.

maya: paste the high-priority items?

alex: TL;DR: 1) scheduler tweak to avoid preempting long jobs -> owner? -> eta 10d; 2) quota backstop + auto-revert -> owner? -> eta 4d; 3) headroom alerts + mitigation runbook -> owner? -> eta 21d; 4) burst node cap to limit noisy neighbors -> owner? -> eta 7d; 5) request-shape sampler + routing experiment -> owner? -> eta 14d.

sam: i'll take scheduler. will prototype + run staging canary.

maya: i'll do quota backstop. plan: terraform change + controller that reverts after 72h unless approved; add audit events.

li: I'll own headroom detection (metrics + simple predictor). pat/eng-sre can co-own mitigation.

alex: assigning: scheduler=sam, quota=maya, detect=li, mitigate=pat, burst=alex, sampler=sam. updating lane doc.

pat: added checklist to playbook (escalation, rollback knobs). link: https://git.internal/redwood/playbooks/capacity

ops-bot: deploybot: canary scheduled: sam/scheduler-proto -> staging at 2026-04-10T15:00Z

sam: ack. will post perf deltas; rollback if p50 >5% or error-rate up.

li: pattern note: 3 similar surges in 6w: long-context gen + embeddings prep. propose tagging requests >6k tokens and routing to a lower-priority pool for isolation.

sam: running a 48h sampler to quantify traffic share, will report.

alex: final action list + due dates: sam: scheduler canary + report -> due 2765510000; maya: quota backstop -> due 2765480000; li: headroom detect prototype -> due 2765640000; pat: mitigation policy + playbook -> due 2765750000; alex: burst cap rollout plan -> due 2765525000; sam: sampler results -> due 2765590000.

maya: i'll add a small finance dashboard tile after quota is live.

sam: weekly 15-min check-in? wed 10am PT works.

alex: scheduled recurring 15-min sync. will publish lane doc and changelog. reopen thread if blockers. :thumbsup:
